name: playwright-typescript-framework
description: Web UI + API automation framework cho AnhTester Book — Playwright TypeScript + Allure 2

scripts.test: node scripts/run-browsers.mjs api ui-chrome ui-edge ui-firefox
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/run-browsers.mjs api ui-chrome ui-edge ui-firefox --grep @smoke
scripts.test:account: node scripts/run-browsers.mjs api ui-chrome ui-edge ui-firefox --grep @account
scripts.test:no-account: node scripts/run-browsers.mjs api ui-chrome ui-edge ui-firefox --grep-invert @account
scripts.report: npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
